regime.summary: Policy rate 15.0% after a +125bp hike on 2022-07-07, bills price more (6M cutoff 15.80%), CPI 21.34% and rising, rupee down 29.3% in 3 months, KSE100 down 12.1% in 3 months. This matches the 2017-19 balance-of-payments squeeze and hike cycle, where the index kept falling and few names rose. Stay mostly cash; no core holdings.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 15.0%; last MPC decision 2022-07-07: hike (+125bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.80pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+8.6pp)
Balance-of-payments squeeze and hike cycle: the index fell 46% to the August 2019 low and 3 of 75 liquid names rose. Lesson: read the rate and the rupee, not the politics.
